---
title: Asis variants
---

## A: stdout plus an execute_result

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print("Printed **markdown**.\n")
"a trailing value"
```

## B: stderr and an IPython Markdown display

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import sys
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
print("to stderr", file=sys.stderr)
display(Markdown("Displayed *markdown*."))
```

## C: echo true

```{python}
#| output: asis
print("Echoed cell, **bold** output.")
```

## D: a class forces the cell div (needCell)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| classes: keepme
print("Inside a **div**.")
```

## E: a tabset (the reporter's use case)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print("::: {.panel-tabset}\n")
for name in ["pip", "conda"]:
    print(f"## {name}\n\n```bash\n{name} install thing\n```\n")
print(":::")
```
